items.title: agent-autoloop
items.description: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
items.summary: agent-autoloop is an open-source tool designed to automate command line agents, allowing them to independently handle tasks in the background without constant user intervention. It is compatible with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT, and aims to reduce manual oversight by automatically managing tasks and only involving the user for decisions that are uncertain. It has received 2,748 stars on GitHub and is maintained by KKKKhazix. The tool is designed to be lightweight and modular, with components that can be easily swapped out. It does not require external dependencies or cloud services, making it a self-hosted solution suitable for Mac or Linux users.

items.title: agent_skills
items.description: Agent skills
items.summary: Agent skills are reusable packages of instructions and context that extend an AI agent's capabilities, providing specialized expertise for specific tasks. They are designed to help agents complete complex workflows that the base large language model might not reliably handle on its own. Skills are knowledge files that tell the agent how to think about a task: what steps to follow, what output format to use, what constraints to respect. Skills load dynamically based on context and run inside the agent’s own context window. They are not prompts, which are ephemeral and reactive, nor are they agents, which are execution runtimes with their own tools, memory, and decision loop. Skills are the right choice when behavior should be portable, reviewable, and swappable without code changes.

items.title: cinecode
items.description: Films made with code. Short films, long YouTube videos, ads, explainers and music videos: an AI coding agent writes the script, builds every frame in code, designs the sound and hands you an MP4.
items.summary: Cinecode is an MIT-licensed project that uses a coding agent to produce videos with JavaScript, headless Chrome, Web Audio, and an MP4 mastering pipeline. It renders each frame deterministically in headless Chrome via Canvas 2D or three.js, and it has two modes: Quick for single-file films under ~3 minutes and Film for long-form, research-backed work. The repository has attracted 2 GitHub stars and ships with eight preset looks, a named camera vocabulary, licensing-clean fonts and samples, and -14 LUFS audio mastering. The toolkit is free and open-source, but access to Claude Code may require a paid subscription.

items.title: sand3d
items.description: 3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.
items.summary: Sandflow's sand3d is a Python library for 3D modeling built for LLMs, allowing AI models to write 3D objects as short programs in a few hundred tokens. It operates over Blender's `bpy` and enables writing 3D objects as profiles, solids, edits, joints, and assemblies. The library is open source on GitHub and is actively maintained, with a live documentation site and support for Python 3.11 and 3.13, and Blender's `bpy` 4.5 and 5.2. It is licensed under Apache-2.0.

items.title: gputaskman
items.description: A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights (Windows AMD and NVIDIA).
items.summary: gputaskman is an open-source GPU task manager developed by Microsoft engineer Scott Hanselman, available for Windows, Linux, and macOS. It provides per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and insights into LLM model/KV-cache usage, specifically for Windows AMD and NVIDIA GPUs. The tool aims to help users understand GPU memory consumption and the specifics of AI and LLM workloads. It includes features like GPU memory counters, model-memory estimates, and text and JSON snapshots for before-and-after comparisons. The project is experimental and its estimates of model identification and memory breakdowns are not definitive.

items.title: pinky
items.description: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
items.summary: Pinky lets any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone from macOS, Windows, or Linux, with you in the loop. It enables agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or a script to operate a real phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over, and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent. To use Pinky, plug the phone into the computer, unlock it, and trust the computer. On Windows, install Apple Devices from the Microsoft Store or iTunes first; on Linux, install the `usbmuxd` package. On the iPhone, turn on Developer Mode in Settings › Privacy & Security.

items.title: vork
items.description: Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview.
items.summary: vork is a headless 3D and VFX engine built for agents, written in Rust and Slang, with GPU rendering through Vulkan and Metal. It allows agents to write a scene, render it, inspect the result, and revise the code. The cache is under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\vork` on Windows. To install, use `py -m pip install "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\vork\\python"` and `npm install "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\vork\\sdk"`. Import as `vork` in Python or `@usevoyager/vork` in TypeScript. Demos include a million-bird flocking simulation, a Schwarzschild black hole, and VFX composited onto real footage. Final renders run 1.4-2.3x faster than Blender EEVEE on timing, though at lower sample counts with visible quality trade-offs.

items.title: devvm
items.description: One VM for every project. An isolated sandbox with your project’s toolchain, ready for you or a coding agent to start coding
items.summary: Devvm creates an isolated VM sandbox for each project, equipped with the toolchain required by the project's files, allowing coding agents or developers to start coding. It runs tools like Claude Code, Codex, and opencode inside the VM, includes Docker, Nix, and desktop layers, and defaults new VMs to an allowlist network tier. The project lands in a crowded space of VM/container sandboxing tools for coding agents, with many commenters noting similarities to Docker Sandbox and skepticism about its resource use, scope, and trust model. The coding agent runs inside the VM's shell rather than being installed on the host machine, ensuring that any attack on the agent stays within the sandbox. The VM mounts the project folder at the same path but otherwise sees nothing else in the home folder, and secrets like a Claude Code token or Codex login stay on the host while devvm's proxy inserts real credentials into outgoing requests.

items.summary: The turkish-anti-ai-skill, developed by Yüce Zerey, is an open-source tool that cleans up AI-generated Turkish texts by removing mechanical, translation-like phrases and reconstructing authentic Turkish sentence structures. It is Python-based and offers CLI support to measure AI density, TDK errors, and sentence length variation. items.summary: The sources describe a process to turn a single image into a 3D sculpt using various AI agents and tools. The GitHub repository "image-to-sculpt" by gokayfem details a skill for coding agents that fits a watertight sculpt to the image's normals, outline, and depth, completing unseen sides from generated views and recording every step for Blender replay. The YouTube video by Bad Decisions Studio explains a workflow orchestrated by AI agents that identifies objects in an image and generates a fully interactive 3D environment. The MCPMarket tool "image-to-3d-pipeline" by guia-matthieubyguia-matthieu transforms 2D images into animated 3D models for web and game development.

items.title: PromptReel
items.description: Free desktop app that turns a text prompt into a short video clip on your own PC. Local AI text-to-video with Wan 2.2: type a scene, pick wide, vertical or square, get an MP4. No credits, no subscription, no queue. Windows 10/11.
items.summary: The sources describe AI text-to-video tools that allow users to generate videos from text prompts. Vidu AI offers a feature where users can type a scene, pick a style, and generate a video with multiple shots and sound. Synthesia provides a free service where users can type in text to get a video with an AI avatar, no signup required. HeyGen's tool allows users to generate videos from text prompts, adding AI B-roll, animations, and visuals, and can skip the use of a presenter if desired. items.title: flawless-ui-ux
items.description: A UI/UX skill for coding agents to build distinctive, usable interfaces.
items.summary: The sources indicate that flawless-ui-ux is a highly regarded skill for coding agents to build distinctive, usable interfaces. On Hacker News, it is mentioned that flawless-ui-ux, along with other skills like Impeccable and Diffui, requires human feedback for UI/UX work. On AgenticSkills, flawless-ui-ux is described as an official skill that teaches agents the CLI v4, registry system, component patterns, and Tailwind v4 config. Additionally, the impeccable.style website praises flawless-ui-ux for its significant impact on UI, UX, branding, and reducing AI slop, establishing a standard for projects.

items.summary: The sources provide details on various AI coding plans and their pricing. For instance, the 阿里云百炼 Coding Plan offers a Lite starter package at 40元/月, with API request limits of 1200次 per 5小时, 9000次 per week, and 18000次 per month. The 火山方舟 (Byte Dance) Coding Plan also starts at 40元/月 with similar API request limits. The 智谱GLM Coding Plan, however, starts at 49元/月 with a limit of 80次 per 5小时 and 400次 per week, with no monthly limit. The sources also mention that Kimi has switched to a token-based pricing model, charging based on input and output tokens, with a current promotion reducing the limit to 1/3 after a limited time.

items.title: open-source-hands
items.description: Make webcam hand games in the browser, or point your coding agent here and have it make one. MediaPipe hand tracking + a gesture engine + a starter game + a playbook.
items.summary: The GitHub repository "open-source-hands" by abouchedidxcode provides a framework for making webcam hand games in the browser using MediaPipe hand tracking, a gesture engine, a starter game, and a playbook. It includes 20 poses, 16 motions, and 5 two-hand gestures, along with continuous values like pinch strength and palm position. The ITP Camp 2024 session on MediaPipe highlights its use for creating interactive webpages that respond to body movements, including hand and face tracking. The DEV Community article describes a real-time hand tracking platform built entirely in the browser using MediaPipe for detection and Three.js for rendering.

items.title: gpt-anime-denoise
items.description: Remove the fish-scale noise GPT image models leave in anime / TV-anime images (ESRGAN @60% + L0 smoothing)
items.summary: To remove fish-scale noise from anime or TV-anime images, the sources suggest using ESRGAN at 60% and L0 smoothing. The first source recommends explicitly instructing the model to avoid repeating noise templates by adding text like "smooth, soft, no repetitive patterns" to the prompt. The second source emphasizes the importance of denoise values between 0.30 and 0.40 for effective noise removal without distorting features. The third source highlights Real-ESRGAN as a practical algorithm for image restoration. Combining these methods can help achieve a smoother, artifact-free anime image.

items.title: NamiDSH
items.description: 对照 DeepSeek Harness 的迷你学习项目：迷你版 Cordis + 迷你版 DSH + 网页端 Agent
items.summary: The sources indicate that DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source agent runtime built on Cordis, a plugin framework where everything is a plugin. The GitHub repository for learning DeepSeek Harness from scratch details how to rebuild a minimal version, Mini-dsh, using only Python's standard library. The Cordis framework is described as a paradigm for spatio-temporal composability, allowing components to be added or removed cleanly. The DeepSeek Harness review mentions the use of a profile to install and run the agent, and the plugin architecture allows the agent loop itself to be a swappable plugin. The sources do not provide specific details about a "迷你版 DSH + 网页端 Agent" project.
